four_sides.factual: Offers condolence and praises the baby's appearance.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows being moved by the child's picture.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the baby as a person worth admiring, not just a tragedy.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the child be seen as beautiful.

segments.why: Tends the parents while honouring the child as someone lovely.

segments.quote: You did nothing wrong but I understand why you would feel guilty because he was your sweet baby that you both longed to have.

four_sides.factual: States the parents are not at fault while accounting for the guilt.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows understanding of how guilt attaches to love.
four_sides.relationship: Refuses to leave the poster in self-blame.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to release the fault.

segments.why: Lifts blame while making room for the feeling, protecting without dismissing.

segments.quote: I wish you all the best for the future stay strong, make memories together and support and listen to each other because your both grieving the same loss but may do it differently there is no right or wrong way 💗🫶🏼

four_sides.factual: Advises mutual support and notes that grief differs between partners.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows practical knowledge of how couples grieve apart.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the couple as needing protection from each other's differences.
four_sides.appeal: Asks them to listen to each other and not judge the difference.

segments.why: Guides two mourners toward each other, the tending practical and forward-looking.

segments.quote: I am so so sorry.

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows sorrow pressed past the standard phrase.
four_sides.relationship: Meets the poster in the loss.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the sorrow be received.

segments.why: Doubles the sorrow to carry weight, mourning alongside while tending.

segments.quote: I hope you know that your baby doesn’t blame you and you shouldn’t either.

four_sides.factual: Asserts the child holds no blame and neither should the parent.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows a wish to reach the poster's guilt directly.
four_sides.relationship: Speaks for the child to release the parent.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to stop self-blaming.

segments.why: Aims directly at another's guilt to lift it, protection given as the whole act.

segments.quote: Horrific!

four_sides.factual: Names the event as horrifying.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows being struck by the severity.
four_sides.relationship: Refuses to minimise what happened to the poster.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the severity be acknowledged.

segments.why: Registers the horror of the event outright rather than softening it.

segments.quote: I am so sorry.

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows sorrow for a stranger.
four_sides.relationship: Stands with the poster.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the condolence be received.

segments.why: Offers plain condolence, tending without elaboration.

segments.quote: I’m so very sorry for your loss .

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence for the loss.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows sorrow on a stranger's behalf.
four_sides.relationship: Stands with the bereaved.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the condolence be received.

segments.why: Offers condolence that both tends the living and marks the loss.

segments.quote: Sending heartfelt condolences and virtual hugs.

four_sides.factual: Sends condolences and hugs at a distance.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows the impulse to physically comfort a stranger.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the poster as someone to hold.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the comfort be felt.

segments.why: Extends physical comfort across distance, tending as the whole act.

segments.quote: John is so beautiful as are the both of you.

four_sides.factual: Calls the baby and the parents beautiful.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows the child seen as a person, named.
four_sides.relationship: Honours the family as a whole.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that they be seen this way.

segments.why: Uses the child's name and honours the family, admiration turned wholly outward.

segments.quote: I am so sorry that this happened.

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence for the event.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows sorrow for the family.
four_sides.relationship: Stands with them.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the condolence be received.

segments.why: Names sorrow at what happened while tending those left.

segments.quote: Sending you and your families lots of love

four_sides.factual: Sends love to the family.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows warmth offered without reserve.
four_sides.relationship: Extends beyond the poster to the wider family.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the love be received.

segments.why: Extends warmth outward to the whole family as the closing act.

segments.quote: I'm so sorry op. I can't imagine how you feel right now but please try and be kind to yourself during this extremely tough time.

four_sides.factual: Offers condolence and urges self-kindness.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows attention aimed at how the poster treats himself.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the poster as at risk of self-punishment.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to be gentle with himself.

segments.why: Directs protection toward the mourner's treatment of himself.

segments.quote: This isn't your fault. There's no blame on what is an absolutely tragic accident.

four_sides.factual: States the death was an accident with no fault.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows a firm position against the poster's self-blame.
four_sides.relationship: Refuses to let the poster hold the guilt.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to drop the blame.

segments.why: Removes fault flatly, the protection stated without hedging.

segments.quote: We lost my little brother recently and my stepdad blamed himself even though it wasn't really his fault.

four_sides.factual: Reports a recent family death and a stepfather's self-blame.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows fresh grief brought forward to be useful.
four_sides.relationship: Claims standing to speak about guilt from experience.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to see the pattern in his own case.

segments.why: Names an own loss in order to make another's guilt legible.

segments.quote: Guilt is incredibly easy to pick up but so hard to get rid of and 9 times out of 10 we put it onto ourselves.

four_sides.factual: Generalises about how guilt is acquired and retained.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows a hard-won understanding offered as tool.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the poster as someone who can use the insight.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to recognise self-imposed guilt.

segments.why: Hands over an understanding of guilt as something usable against it.

segments.quote: My heart goes out to you and your family right now and I'm sending man hugs along with my condolences.

four_sides.factual: Sends condolences and hugs to the family.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows warmth offered in plain terms.
four_sides.relationship: Meets the poster man to man.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the comfort be received.

segments.why: Sends comfort across distance while mourning alongside.

segments.quote: Take care.

four_sides.factual: Closes with a parting instruction.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows continued concern past the message.
four_sides.relationship: Leaves the poster with a charge to look after himself.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to keep himself safe.

segments.why: Closes by charging another with his own safekeeping.

segments.quote: Even puppies?!

four_sides.factual: Queries whether animals are included in the afterlife.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows surprise at a possibility not considered.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the other as holding a view worth probing.
four_sides.appeal: Asks for confirmation.

segments.why: Reaches after a surprising possibility with an open question.

segments.quote: I’d never heard of someone saying pets/animals go to heaven/afterlife. And tbh it’s one of the concepts that makes it hard to believe in heaven.

four_sides.factual: Reports unfamiliarity with the idea and names it as a barrier to belief.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows honest difficulty with the doctrine.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the other as able to handle disagreement.
four_sides.appeal: Invites an answer to the difficulty.

segments.why: Names a live difficulty and keeps working at the question.

segments.quote: Like, what makes us humans so special, that we get to go to heaven? meanwhile creatures who never do evil don’t get that privilege.

four_sides.factual: Asks why humans qualify while blameless animals do not.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows objection to an arrangement seen as unfair.
four_sides.relationship: Challenges the doctrine rather than the person.
four_sides.appeal: Demands a justification.

segments.why: Presses an unfairness in the arrangement while still asking rather than accusing.

segments.quote: I know one “explanation” might be that people get freedom to choose so I guess it counts more when we consciously choose not to be evil, but still.

four_sides.factual: Voices the free-will counterargument and marks it as insufficient.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows fairness in stating the opposing case.
four_sides.relationship: Credits the other side with having an answer.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the residual objection stand.

segments.why: Steelmans the opposing case before holding the objection open.

segments.quote: My son left with his Nana.

four_sides.factual: States that a son died in the company of his grandmother.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows the death held as a departure rather than an end.
four_sides.relationship: Confirms the poster's picture from own experience.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that the account be taken as corroboration.

segments.why: Names a child's death in the poster's own frame, the loss stated plainly.

segments.quote: He told me. I believe ❤️

four_sides.factual: Reports the son said so and states belief in it.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows a settled conviction that carries comfort.
four_sides.relationship: Offers the poster testimony to lean on.
four_sides.appeal: Invites the poster to believe it too.

segments.why: States a settled belief about the dead and offers it to steady another.

segments.quote: I have worked in nursing homes since I was 17 years old. I have seen countless people die in the ~10 years I’ve done this job.

four_sides.factual: Reports a decade of nursing home work and many deaths witnessed.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows long exposure to dying held without drama.
four_sides.relationship: Establishes standing to speak to the poster's hope.
four_sides.appeal: Asks that what follows be trusted.

segments.why: Grounds standing in years of tending the dying before offering comfort.

segments.quote: I can tell you, you *are* going to see your loved ones at the end of your life. It is so, so common for people to start “hallucinating” dead relatives.

four_sides.factual: Asserts that seeing dead relatives at the end of life is very common.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows willingness to state it as near-certain.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the poster's hope as deserving a firm answer.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to take the reassurance.

segments.why: Gives a firm reassurance drawn from work with the dying.

segments.quote: I’ve never noticed them do it with a living relative, which is why I have hallucinating in quotes, I’m not entirely convinced it’s just a hallucination.

four_sides.factual: Notes the visions never involve living relatives and questions the hallucination label.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows observation leading past the standard explanation.
four_sides.relationship: Treats the reader as able to weigh the anomaly.
four_sides.appeal: Invites the reader to consider the pattern.

segments.why: Follows an observed anomaly past the ready explanation, curiosity kept open.

segments.quote: But even if it is, it will be real for you.

four_sides.factual: States the experience will be real to the dying person regardless of cause.
four_sides.self_revelation: Shows comfort offered without requiring belief.
four_sides.relationship: Protects the poster's hope from the sceptical reading.
four_sides.appeal: Asks the poster to keep the comfort either way.

segments.why: Preserves another's comfort without demanding the metaphysics be settled.
